# VNMSFX

> Rapid response ops for food & beverage (CPG) brands, New York. VNMSFX builds the AI-native system that catches what slipped — a wholesale account gone quiet, a distributor deduction deadline closing, a Meta ad buying clicks for a sold-out flavor, a paid subscription with no matching shipment — and puts it, with the evidence, in front of the right person. Run your business like you have an ops team, without hiring one: a small team operates like a funded one, without the ops payroll or the dilution. Wired to the tools the brand already uses (Shopify, QuickBooks, Notion, Claude, Gmail). Built once, owned by the client. Founder: Brandon Adams.

## Engagements
- Free teardown (30 min): you show me where things live; I name two leaks I'd go after first. Book: https://cal.com/vnmsfx/30min
- The leak audit ($2,500): a week inside the agreed records; findings with the evidence behind them and a build map, yours either way; refundable before work begins; credits toward the build. Sample deliverable (fictional company): https://vnmsfx.com/sample-audit
- The build ($5,000/mo x 3): one piece at a time, biggest leak first; first piece live in the build's first two weeks; month three is the training month.
- Payment schedule, audit through handover: audit $2,500, then build month one $2,500 (that month's $5,000 less the audit credit), month two $5,000, month three $5,000. $15,000 all-in, not $17,500.
- What the audit is vs the build: the audit is a snapshot — what is being missed, the evidence behind each finding, and a build map, yours either way. The running system that keeps watching, the connections behind it, and the drafted actions that go out on approval are the build.
- The partnership ($2,500/mo, optional, after the build): monthly review, priority fixes, upgrades.
- Introductory pricing: the offer is new and priced that way. The rate holds until the first two case studies, then rises.

## Terms
Client owns everything — accounts, logins, data, the system itself. No platform to migrate to, no lock-in, no operations taken over. Three clients at a time. Data handling: least-privilege access inside client-owned accounts via named collaborator, service-account, OAuth or client-created export — never a shared password; named business-tier AI processors under commercial terms; human approval before anything acts (https://vnmsfx.com/security). Plain-language terms: https://vnmsfx.com/terms
